name: Debian
content:
#!ipxe
# Logic: [arch] [detect] [set]
echo "Detecting architecture..."

# Default to i386
set arch i386

# Detect x86_64
cpuid --ext 29 && set arch amd64 ||

# Detect ARM64
iseq ${buildarch} arm64 && set arch arm64 ||

echo "Target architecture identified as: ${arch}"

# Netboot.xyz recommended variables
set debian_version {{ .debian_version }}
set mirror http://deb.debian.org
set base_dir debian
set mirrorcfg mirror/suite=${debian_version}
set preseedurl http://192.168.69.1:8080/a/4b0f5cd7-2b1c-40fd-aa19-0ecbd6c34fca/debian-pressed.cfg

# Construct directory path
set base-url ${mirror}/${base_dir}/dists/${debian_version}/main/installer-${arch}/current/images/netboot/debian-installer/${arch}

# Clear previous images from memory
imgfree

# Loading components
echo "Fetching Debian kernel for ${arch}..."
# Localization passed via kernel args to prevent initial prompts
kernel ${base-url}/linux auto=true priority=critical locale=de_DE.UTF-8 keymap=de-latin1-nodeadkeys console-setup/ask_detect=false ${mirrorcfg} preseed/url=${preseedurl} interface=auto hostname=debian-${arch} domain=local.lan initrd=initrd.gz -- quiet || goto error

echo "Fetching initrd..."
initrd ${base-url}/initrd.gz || goto error

# Execution
echo "Booting installer..."
boot || goto error

:error
echo "[ERROR] Script failed! Check network/URL. Dropping to shell."
shell
exit 1
